# NFL Daily — 2026-10-22 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Giants named J.J. McCarthy their new starting quarterback. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/nfl-catchup-giants-go-j-j-mccarthy-josh-jacobs-back-practice)
- NFL fined Patriots coach Mike Vrabel, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni and Jets coach Aaron Glenn near-record amounts, per report. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-punishes-patriots-eagles-jets-head-coaches-record-fines/)
- Titans released DT Jordan Elliott after an incident involving a firearm at the team facility. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/titans-release-jordan-elliott-after-incident/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) was limited again in practice and is questionable for Sunday's game vs. the Bengals. [Baltimore Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/baltimore-ravens-cincinnati-bengals-lamar-jackson-injury-UC2HDNP2YVC3HIB4CNUX3AKVOY/)
- Eagles RB Saquon Barkley is expected to practice and in line to play Sunday vs. the Cowboys. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50248869/sources-eagles-barkley-expected-practice-play-vs-cowboys)
- Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield is expected to start Sunday vs. the Panthers, barring setbacks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50252035/barring-setbacks-mayfield-expects-start-buccaneers)
- Patriots placed starting G Alijah Vera-Tucker on injured reserve. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2113360391497822433)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-22 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- C Cam Jurgens, acquired in the Oct. 7 trade from the Eagles, is out of concussion protocol and says he's ready for his expected Ravens debut Sunday against the Bengals. [Baltimore Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/cam-jurgens-exits-concussion-protocol-discusses-ravens-debut-trade)
- QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) returned to practice but remains limited; he's questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals. [Baltimore Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/baltimore-ravens-cincinnati-bengals-lamar-jackson-injury-UC2HDNP2YVC3HIB4CNUX3AKVOY/)

# Rivals — 2026-10-22 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Steelers: a planned fan event in Paris was canceled amid civil unrest ahead of Sunday's game vs. the Saints; the game itself remains on as scheduled. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50250407/steelers-fan-event-paris-canceled-amid-civil-unrest)
- Bills: S C.J. Gardner-Johnson's one-game suspension (for a spitting incident) was upheld on appeal; he'll miss next week's game against the Ravens. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2113286397478199799)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Chiefs: LT Josh Simmons was placed on injured reserve (bulging disc) and isn't eligible to return until Week 11. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-to-place-josh-simmons-on-injured-reserve/)
- Steelers: DE Sebastian Joseph-Day was placed on injured reserve; rookies will step into the Steelers' D-line rotation. [Post-Gazette](https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/steelers/2026/10/22/steelers-injury-updates/stories/202610210074)
- Browns: LB Quincy Williams (neck) sat out practice and is questionable. [Mary Kay Cabot](https://x.com/MaryKayCabot/status/2113361388957507908)
- Browns: RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is listed as questionable. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
